title: Memory check (dementia screening)
what: The doctor asks questions and gives simple tasks for memory, attention and thinking. This helps notice memory problems early.
why: When you or your family notice forgetfulness, confusion or trouble with everyday tasks.
duration: the test usually takes 15 to 30 minutes, the visit about an hour
tell_doctor: What exactly has changed and for how long
Trouble with money, medicines or finding the way
All your medicines - some affect memory

prepare.title: Close person
prepare.text: It is good if a close person comes - they can tell what they have noticed.

prepare.title: Sleep
prepare.text: Get a good night's sleep and eat before the visit.

prepare.title: Glasses
prepare.text: Bring your glasses and hearing aid - without them the test will not be accurate.

bring: Discharge summaries and tests, if you have them
steps: The doctor asks you and your close person questions
Gives tasks: remember words, say the date, draw a clock
If needed, orders blood tests and an MRI
feel: You may feel nervous or awkward if something does not work out - this is normal
after: If the test shows changes, the doctor will order further tests
Some causes can be treated: lack of vitamins, thyroid problems, depression
The test is usually repeated after some time
red_flags: Sudden confusion, weakness in an arm or leg, or trouble speaking - call your local emergency number

faq.q: Does the test give a diagnosis right away?
faq.a: No. The test is only the first step. An exam and further tests are needed for conclusions.

faq.q: Can I prepare for the test?
faq.a: You do not need to prepare. Just sleep well and bring your glasses.

reminders.text: Memory check tomorrow. Take your glasses and list of medicines and, if you can, bring a close person.
